title: English Practice Quiz 0855
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Conflict Resolution: Two colleagues disagree. What is a constructive first step?
options: Hear both perspectives and clarify the issue
questions.explanation: Listening helps identify the actual issue.

questions.question: Conflict Resolution: What is an objective statement?
questions.explanation: Objective language focuses on verifiable facts.

questions.question: Conflict Resolution: What should difficult feedback focus on?
options: Specific behaviour and its work impact
questions.explanation: Specific behaviour and impact make feedback constructive.

questions.question: Conflict Resolution: What is a compromise?
options: Each party makes concessions to reach agreement

questions.question: Conflict Resolution: A disagreement becomes threatening. What should you do?
questions.explanation: Safety procedures and escalation take priority.

questions.question: Conflict Resolution: Which question encourages problem-solving?
options: What practical change would help prevent this again?

questions.question: Conflict Resolution: What does mediation involve?
options: A neutral person helps parties discuss a dispute
questions.explanation: A mediator facilitates discussion without taking sides.

questions.question: Conflict Resolution: What makes a resolution fair?
options: Consistent with policy and relevant facts
questions.explanation: Fair decisions rely on facts and consistent rules.

questions.question: Conflict Resolution: What should parties do after agreeing on a solution?
Conflict Resolution: When is escalation appropriate?
options: The issue exceeds your authority or remains unresolved
questions.explanation: Escalation brings issues to the appropriate level.
